{"calls":[{"tool":"finish","id":null,"version":"3.0.0","notes":"# quaykit 3.0.0

This release changes the default handling of completed jobs, fixes lock release when handlers throw synchronously, and adds JSON output to `quaykit inspect`.

## Breaking Changes

- Completed jobs are now removed by default. Set `removeOnComplete` to `false` to retain them. (#307)

## Features

- `quaykit inspect --json` prints queue statistics as JSON. (#318)

## Fixes

- Release the worker lock when a job handler throws synchronously. (#304)","bump":"major","sections":["Breaking Changes","Features","Fixes"]}]}

# quaykit 3.0.0

This release changes the default handling of completed jobs, fixes lock release when handlers throw synchronously, and adds JSON output to `quaykit inspect`.

## Breaking Changes

- Completed jobs are now removed by default. Set `removeOnComplete` to `false` to retain them. (#307)

## Features

- `quaykit inspect --json` prints queue statistics as JSON. (#318)

## Fixes

- Release the worker lock when a job handler throws synchronously. (#304)
